records.title: A Decade of Evidence of Trend Following Investing in Cryptocurrencies
records.claim: Walk-forward crypto trend-following evidence; code is publicly linked.

records.title: Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins
records.claim: Multi-lookback Donchian trend ensemble with volatility sizing, liquid-universe selection and fee-aware testing.

records.title: Momentum in the Cryptocurrency Market: A Comprehensive Analysis under Realistic Assumptions
records.claim: Time-series momentum is more robust than cross-sectional momentum under realistic liquidation and market assumptions.

records.title: Trend-following Strategies for Crypto Investors
records.claim: Crypto trend-following performance is materially affected by transaction costs.

records.title: Machine Learning-Based Bitcoin Trading Under Transaction Costs: Evidence From Walk-Forward Forecasting
records.claim: Naive hourly signals can fail after costs; cost-aware execution thresholds can reduce turnover and preserve selected edges.

records.title: Bollinger Bands under Varying Market Regimes: Breakout and Mean-Reversion in BTC/USDT
records.claim: Breakout versus mean-reversion performance is regime-dependent; persistent directional phases punish indiscriminate mean reversion.

records.title: Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy with Tape Speed Confirmation for Cryptocurrency Futures Markets
records.claim: Five-minute SOL perpetual mean reversion uses prior-day volume-profile levels plus momentum confirmation; tight stops can be consumed by fees/slippage.

records.title: Evaluating a Donchian Channel Breakout Strategy with ATR-Based Risk Management
records.claim: BTC Donchian breakout with ATR volatility/risk filtering is viable only under parameter, cost and regime sensitivity checks.

records.title: Cross-sectional Momentum in Cryptocurrency Markets
records.claim: Short-horizon cross-sectional momentum is a portfolio-level prior, not an intraday execution rule.

records.title: Revisiting Trend-following and Mean-Reversion Strategies in Bitcoin
records.claim: Extended OOS evidence favors local-maximum trend rules over local-minimum mean-reversion robustness.

records.title: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction
records.claim: Six-hour trend framework combines volatility-aware trailing, asset selection, asymmetric long/short allocation and OOS robustness tests.

records.title: Learning and Predictability via Technical Analysis: Evidence from Bitcoin
records.claim: Price-to-moving-average ratios forecast daily Bitcoin returns in- and out-of-sample and support rule-based trend context.

records.title: Seasonality, Trend-following, and Mean reversion in Bitcoin
records.claim: Bitcoin shows intraday seasonality plus distinct trend-at-highs and rebound-at-lows behavior.

records.title: How To Profitably Trade Bitcoin's Overnight Sessions?
records.claim: Bitcoin 24/7 behavior differs across intraday and overnight windows, supporting explicit session-state testing.

records.title: Bitcoin at High Frequency
records.claim: Bitcoin exhibits intraday seasonality and time-varying return predictability at horizons up to hours, plus strong jump and volatility structure.

records.title: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures
records.claim: Quarter-hour opening order imbalance in six perpetual contracts forecasts four-to-twelve-hour returns out of sample.

records.title: High-Frequency Jump Analysis of the Bitcoin Market
records.claim: Order-flow imbalance, aggressive-trader dominance and spread widening predict Bitcoin jumps in the studied tick data.

records.title: Explainable Patterns in Cryptocurrency Microstructure
records.claim: Stable order-book/trade feature relationships appear across multiple Binance perpetuals with time-series CV and tradability checks.

records.title: Order-Flow Imbalance and Short-Horizon Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Markets
records.claim: Provides a reproducible framework to distinguish predictive OFI from contemporaneous mechanical price impact.

records.title: Modelling Crypto Asset Order-Flow Imbalance as an Additive and Multiplicative Process
records.claim: State-dependent OFI dynamics provide a regime representation linked to leveraged and trend-following pressure.

records.title: Funding Rate Mechanism in Perpetual Futures
records.claim: Funding acts as an endogenous feedback rule and interacts with basis, momentum traders and liquidation-driven stress.

records.title: Constructing Cointegrated Cryptocurrency Portfolios for Statistical Arbitrage
records.claim: Cointegration-based cryptocurrency portfolios support explicit threshold and risk-constrained statistical-arbitrage testing.

records.title: Cryptocurrency Pair Trading
records.claim: Cointegration selection generally outperforms distance selection; higher trading frequency increases both opportunity and cost sensitivity.

records.title: Evaluation of Dynamic Cointegration-Based Pairs Trading Strategy in the Cryptocurrency Market
records.claim: Dynamic cointegration, OU half-life and quote-aware execution were tested on BitMEX with explicit microstructure constraints.

records.title: Copula-Based Trading of Cointegrated Cryptocurrency Pairs
records.claim: Copula signals on cointegrated cryptocurrency pairs provide a distinct statistical-arbitrage family for independent validation.

records.title: Arbitrage Opportunities and Efficiency Tests in Crypto Derivatives
records.claim: BTC/ETH options-perpetual cross-market arbitrage remains cost- and liquidity-dependent, supporting derivative-state context rather than naked signal copying.

records.title: Bitcoin Arbitrage: The Role of a Single Exchange
records.claim: Cross-exchange Bitcoin arbitrage opportunity concentration and lifetime vary materially by venue and volatility.

records.title: Do Order-Book States Predict Passive-Buy Toxicity? Evidence from BTC Perpetual Futures
records.claim: Local BTC perpetual order-flow, near-touch absorption and liquidity fragility are tested as predictors of future returns and adverse selection.

records.title: Detecting Volatility Regimes in Crypto Markets using Realized Volatility Structure and Normalized Momentum
records.claim: Expansion, neutral and contraction regimes can be classified from relative realized-volatility structure plus normalized directional momentum.

records.title: Technical Analysis Meets Machine Learning: Bitcoin Evidence
records.claim: Compares EMA and MACD+ADX technical rules against ML models on Bitcoin; use as comparative evidence, not direct deployment authority.

records.title: Demystifying Time-Series Momentum Strategies
records.claim: TSMOM robustness depends on volatility estimator, rule design, correlations and transaction-cost control.

records.title: Does Trend-Following Still Work on Stocks?
records.claim: High turnover can destroy trend-following economics; turnover control is a first-class design variable.

records.title: Designing funding rates for perpetual futures in cryptocurrency markets
records.claim: Funding-rate design affects perpetual-to-target price alignment and is part of the economic holding-cost state.

records.title: FROM SIGNAL TO STRATEGY: DYNAMIC BITCOIN ALLOCATION USING THE MEDIA PRESSURE INDEX
records.claim: A media-pressure regime signal is tested as a dynamic Bitcoin exposure control with OOS evaluation; retain as optional orthogonal-family evidence.

records.title: Trading Strategy AI getting-started examples
records.claim: Public examples include BTC/multipair ATR breakouts on 15m/1h and higher-timeframe regime logic.

records.title: BTC Breakout trend follower with a volatility-adjusted trailing stop
records.claim: Public BTC breakout implementation uses ATR-based initial/activation/trailing stops and explicitly discusses uncorrelated systems/timeframes.

records.title: trend-following-backtesting-strategies
records.claim: Public variant sweep compares Donchian, ATR risk, momentum gates, staged targets and trailing; useful for ablation hypotheses only.

records.title: geektrade-strategies volatility squeeze momentum
records.claim: Public crypto squeeze-breakout combines compression, ATR-margin breakout, momentum and volume confirmation on slower timeframes.

records.title: Breakout Trading Strategy: Does It Work on Crypto?
records.claim: Published ETH 4h Bollinger breakout case provides a transparent public rule/backtest candidate for independent reproduction, not proof.

records.title: Donchian Channel Breakout Strategy: Backtested on BTC
records.claim: Published BTC Donchian rule set discusses low breakout win-rate, fees and losing windows; useful as both implementation and negative-control prior.

records.title: BTC Trend-Momentum Strategy
records.claim: Open-source Bitcoin strategy combines EMA200 trend, CMF volume pressure, Stoch RSI timing and optional ATR-volatility filter; no built-in stop/target, so risk logic must be independently designed.

records.title: Simple Bitcoin strategy
records.claim: Public QuantConnect Bitcoin RSI+EMA framework is a simple-rule comparison baseline, not evidence of transferable profitability.

records.title: r/algotrading: live strategy discussion
records.claim: Practitioners repeatedly describe high candidate kill rates, simple rule-based hypotheses, diversification across uncorrelated systems, sensitivity checks and cost drag control.

records.title: r/algotrading: Do technical analysis work?
records.claim: A crypto automation practitioner reports common use of 2-3 orthogonal indicator classes; treat performance assertions as anecdotal.

records.title: Bitcointalk breakout-retest success thread
records.claim: High-read anecdotal discussion repeatedly describes breakout confirmation, retest entry and structure-based stops; success claims are unverified.

records.title: Bitcointalk: Top bitcoin trading strategies
records.claim: Forum taxonomy repeatedly names trend, breakout, hedging, scalping and arbitrage; no economic proof is assigned.

records.title: Failure of Cross-Sectional Alpha Screening on Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures
records.claim: Systematic screening of OHLCV/funding cross-sectional factors on perpetuals produced a failure case, warning against assuming feature-library alpha.

records.title: QuantConnect Strategy Discussion 179 corrected crypto result
records.claim: A complex crypto mean-reversion/ML example reportedly collapsed after a data correction, illustrating data-integrity and complexity risk.

records.title: On Cointegration and Cryptocurrency Dynamics
records.claim: Strong in-sample cointegration statistical-arbitrage performance weakens OOS, enforcing fresh-OOS and regime checks for pairs families.

youtube.rule: Only direct youtube.com/watch URL + visible verified view count + extractable rule set can enter discovery evidence; music/help/search-redirect domains are rejected.
